newsitem.title: INDIA: India Essar offers to buy into Sterling Computers.
newsitem.headline: India Essar offers to buy into Sterling Computers.

text.p: India's Essar Group of companies on Friday said the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) had cleared Essar Investment Ltd's open offer to buy 20 percent of Sterling Computers Ltd shares at 532 rupees per share.
"This means that the shareholder would be benefited by more than 100 percent with the share currently trading around 263 rupees on the Bombay Stock Exchange," it said in a statement.
The offer will open on February 12 and is valid till March 12, it said.
Essar said three unlisted firms, now under its fold, already hold 80 percent of the equity of Sterling Computers.

Sterling Computers holds 51 percent in Sterling Cellular, the cellular telephone licencee for Delhi. Sterling Cellular in turn holds 80 percent of Aircell Digilink, the cellular licencee for eastern Uttar Pradesh, Haryana and Rajasthan, it said.
